subject: 🏃 Friday — Stability & Power, Pre-Flight (Wk 5)
html:
Tomorrow: Stability & Power at Lynx Fitness Club, 5:30 AM ET — your last Boston session before the 9:07 AM flight home. Time is tight, so move with purpose. Warm-up: foam roll + 90/90 PAILs 30s each + banded lateral walks 10 each direction + Spanish squat hold 30s + Copenhagen 20s each side.

PT block goes FIRST — non-negotiable. It's been dropped to time crunch on two of the last three loaded Fridays, and that pattern stops here. Side plank w/ hip abduction (top toe down, 8 reps/side), dead bug w/ banded pulldown (2–3×10 slow marches), chin tuck + lifts (2 each direction, 3s hold). Then the full Rx:

ExerciseWeightSets × Reps
Bulgarian split squat25 lb/hand3 × 8–10 (3s eccentric)
Single-leg RDL (contralateral)25 lb single DB3 × 8–10 (3s eccentric)
Spanish squat holdLight band (wall sit if Lynx doesn't stock bands)3 × 30–45s
Copenhagen plankBodyweight3 × 30s/side

Knee gate: Wednesday's 2/5 on stairs was the first non-1 reading of the entire V6 build. Lower-body load is frozen for the week — hold all weights exactly as listed, no bumps. If the knee read 2+ during today's Esplanade run, take that signal seriously tomorrow: do the PT block and Bulgarians at reduced depth, skip the SL-RDL if anything is talking. If it read 3+ today, the session converts to PT block + bodyweight mobility only — no loaded single-leg work.

Focus cue: capture feel ratings for both Bulgarian and single-leg RDL. Neither exercise has had a clean feel rating logged in the last two loaded Fridays. I need that data to know if 25 lb is still the right load or if you're ready to progress once the knee clears.

Hard stop for the flight: if the clock is running short, PT block + Bulgarians are the keepers — drop Spanish squat and Copenhagen before those. Getting the PT exercises done and one loaded single-leg pattern logged is worth more than four exercises rushed with poor form.

Context: Week 5 of 12, Phase 2 (Strength & Threshold) — 51 days to the SF Marathon. The Boston week delivered: 5 threshold miles on the Esplanade Tuesday, squat to 175 and calf raises unlocked Wednesday, and a progression run today. Tomorrow closes the road trip. Saturday is a 3 mi shakeout after travel, then Sunday's 12 mi long run kicks off the Phase 2 volume ramp with 90 g/hr gut training.

Tonight: Set a 5:15 AM alarm, lay out gym clothes and your flight bag. Hydrate well — hotel air plus post-run dehydration compounds. Bed by 10 PM ET. You gain 3 hours back tomorrow; use the flight to rest, not catch up on work.
